mapper.sql: id, company_id, user_id, balance, frozen, total_recharge, total_consume, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM opc_wallet WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO opc_wallet (company_id, user_id, balance, frozen, total_recharge, total_consume, status, create_by, create_time) VALUES (#{companyId}, #{userId}, #{balance}, #{frozen}, #{totalRecharge}, #{totalConsume}, #{status}, #{createBy}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE opc_wallet SET balance = balance - #{amount}, total_consume = total_consume + #{amount}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND balance >= #{amount}
UPDATE opc_wallet SET balance = balance + #{amount}, total_recharge = total_recharge + #{amount}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
